parties: Palliyapattuge Malika v. Hon. Attorney-General Palliyapattuge Malika v. Hon. Attorney-General View More
keywords: Criminal appeal – Possession of 14.02 grams of heroin – Life imprisonment – Trial Judge referring to Information Book notes – Police statements and non-summary material not substantive evidence – Distinction between referring to prior material and using it substantively – Contradictions in testimony – Lapse of time – Credibility and testimonial trustworthiness – Material and immaterial contradictions – Conviction upheld.
legistation: Poisons, Opium and Dangerous Drugs Ordinance – section 54A; evidentiary rules governing police statements, Information Book entries and substantive evidence.
